description.en-US: Chesterton's study of the radical journalist and countryman: his self-made youth, his tragedy as a patriot, his Political Register, his Rural Rides, his History of the Protestant Reformation, and a man who saw clearly what the industrial age would do to the English land.
description.pt-BR: O estudo de Chesterton sobre o jornalista radical e homem do campo: sua juventude de autodidata, sua tragédia de patriota, seu Political Register, seus Rural Rides, sua História da Reforma Protestante, e um homem que viu claramente o que a era industrial faria com a terra inglesa.

sources.edition: William Cobbett (Hodder & Stoughton, 1925), Project Gutenberg Australia, ebooks09/0900441h.
sources.description: Chapter divisions as printed; Gutenberg front and back matter dropped, line wraps joined, underscored italics converted, double hyphens set as em dashes. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Public domain in Brazil, the UK and the EU (Chesterton died in 1936). Published in 1925; text taken from Project Gutenberg Australia, which carries it under Australian law.

title.en-US: Revolution and the Bones of Paine
